syllabus_topics: Definition and examples of vector spaces
Kernel and image of a linear transformation
Solution space of a linear equation
Examples of applications (e.g. systems of linear ordinary differential equations with constant coefficients, stability of linear dynamic systems, Markov chains, PageRank algorithm)
Singular value decomposition of a transformation between Euclidean spaces
assessment_rules: The provisional final grade (NF) is the maximum of the average of the three MAP45 tests or the Recovery Exam (E), rounded to the nearest integer. The score of one MAP45 can be replaced by a better score from the corresponding MAP45 recovery. If a student does not attend any MAP45 or exam, their score for that test counts as 0. Approval in the course requires a final grade of 10 or higher. For NF > 17, an optional Oral Exam can be taken; if not attended, the final grade is 17.
